reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's dated complete USDY Portfolio Overview, as of October 28, 2026 19:59:59 EDT (2026-10-28T23:59:59Z), reports four positions: US Treasuries $2,095,324,005; SHVon $318,779,300; Silicon Valley Bank bank deposits $599,221; other cash and equivalents $10,821. Their exact sum equals the same-page current-value total of $2,414,713,347; weights use only this common denominator. The page also reports WAM 171.59 days, YTM 4.10%, value of USDY outstanding $2.06B, value of underlying assets $2.41B and a 152.95% collateralization ratio; the outstanding value and collateralization ratio are issuer supplemental metrics and are not reconciled to circulating liabilities here. This independently dated issuer portfolio supersedes the September 25 LLC composition and the October 19 observation. It does not reconcile current global USDY liabilities, establish all-USDY financial assurance, or assign OGM platform-wide collateral to USDY. The Treasury category WAM and the one-day WAM of SHVon, deposits and cash are not contractual maturity maxima or guaranteed liquidation times; no maturityDaysMax or immediate liquidity is inferred. SHVon retains the issuer tokenized-security layer, conservative high risk and unknown liquidity, rather than direct Treasury or direct ETF-share credit. The small other-cash/equivalents category remains explicitly unclassified. No current individual CUSIP weights are inferred from the older LLC report.
